title: Verify Parts Technician can order a part on a work order line
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Parts Technician role. (this role has Order Parts ON).
At least one work order exists that contains labor and part lines with prices entered.
steps:
1. Open a work order line and open the parts actions.
2. Click Order, select part/vendor/quantity, and confirm.
expected: The part order is created successfully.
